He turns and waves to a group of people on stage who are cheering, clapping, and raising their fists. He then walks back to a podium and begins to speak.

audio_music: The audio consists entirely of ambient sounds from a live event: a crowd chanting "Joe, Joe, Joe!" and loud, enthusiastic cheering and applause. The effect is energetic and supportive.
